rows.description: CRCalculator produces correct CR for 10 known SRD monsters
rows.verifyMethod: Run calculator against Adult Red Dragon (CR17), Goblin (CR1/4), etc. — output matches published CR

rows.description: MonsterGenerator creates stat blocks with stats within ±10% of CR targets
rows.verifyMethod: Generate monsters at CR 1, 5, 10, 15, 20 — compare HP/AC/DPR to DMG tables

rows.description: EncounterBalancer produces correct XP budgets per DMG p82
rows.verifyMethod: Calculate budget for party of 4 level-5 PCs — Easy=1000, Medium=2000, Hard=3000, Deadly=4400

rows.description: LootGenerator rolls from DMG treasure tables with correct distribution
rows.verifyMethod: Generate 10 CR-7 hoards — verify coin ranges and magic item table references match DMG

rows.description: SpellForge creates balanced spells with comparison to SRD precedent
rows.verifyMethod: Create a level-3 damage spell — damage should be comparable to Fireball (8d6)
Feed it a CR-5 monster with CR-15 stats — should flag as overpowered with specific adjustments

rows.description: MonsterArt generates D&D-style creature art via Gemini
rows.verifyMethod: Generate art for 3 different creature types — images saved to ~/Downloads/

rows.description: MapPrompt generates usable battlemaps with grid overlay
rows.verifyMethod: Generate forest battlemap — image has visible grid, terrain features, VTT-appropriate resolution

rows.description: StatBlock outputs valid Foundry VTT JSON
rows.verifyMethod: Generate monster → export --format foundry → import into Foundry VTT → stat block renders correctly

rows.description: CampaignState persists and loads across sessions
